title: France bans alcohol at music festival events under red heatwave alert
teaser: ⚠️ France bans alcohol at music festivals during red heatwave alerts to protect healthcare services during extreme heat.
summary: Due to extreme heatwave conditions, France has issued a directive banning alcohol at public music festivals. This policy change, enforced during periods of a 'red heatwave alert,' is a public health measure designed to help preserve critical healthcare services. The ban affects millions of annual street parties, prioritizing public safety over celebratory consumption during dangerously hot weather.
content: Annual street parties attended by millions ordered to help "preserve" healthcare services in 40C (104F) heat.

title: Backstage at Gorillaz' epic, one-off stadium show: 'The vibe is ridiculous'
teaser: From the chaos of a one-off stadium spectacle: Damon Albarn, De La Soul, and Moonchild Sannelly talk about the 'ridiculous' vibe backstage at Gorillaz' epic show.
summary: Damon Albarn, De La Soul, and Moonchild Sannelly shared insights backstage after Gorillaz' massive, one-off stadium performance. The discussion highlighted the overwhelming and 'ridiculous' vibe of the event. The show marked a major concert moment for the band, capturing the immense energy and collaborative atmosphere of the rock spectacle.
content: Damon Albarn, De La Soul and Moonchild Sannelly talk backstage as Gorillaz play their biggest show.
